one_liner.zh: 高位震荡里 BTC 窗口收 -2.2%，实现波动抬高而期权相对 RV 仍偏贵；杠杆中性、加密偏独立，美现货 BTC ETF 周净流 -2.02 亿美金落在中性/拉锯。
one_liner.en: In high-level chop BTC finished the window -2.2%, realized vol elevated while options stayed rich to RV; leverage neutral and crypto-idiosyncratic, with US spot BTC ETF net -202.40M in a neutral/tug-of-war channel.

zh: BTC ETF 周净流 -2.02 亿美金

risk.zh: 高实现波动叠加 IV 溢价，若路径继续来回扫，拥挤与出清节奏比单边方向更敏感。
risk.en: High realized vol plus IV premium means path whipsaws keep crowding and clearance timing more salient than a one-way bet.

watch.zh: 盯 ETF 日度净流是否从单日深流出再拉回中性，以及 funding/OI 是否仍温和。
watch.en: Watch whether ETF daily nets stay in neutral tug-of-war after the deep single-day outflow, and whether funding/OI remain mild.

vol_premium.zh: 期权偏贵（IV 相对 RV 溢价）

compare.zh: BTC -2.2% 与 ETH -2.3% 几乎同步小幅回撤；传统侧 NQ -2.0%、黄金 -2.7% 同向，ES 仅 -0.6%、VIX 近乎走平、美元微升、美债收益率下行约 6bp。标签仍给「加密偏独立」——相关有重叠，但主导叙事未焊死在同一宏观主线。
compare.en: BTC -2.2% and ETH -2.3% eased in near lockstep; TradFi saw NQ -2.0% and gold -2.7% in the same direction, ES only -0.6%, VIX almost flat, DXY slightly up, US10Y down ~6 bp. The card still tags crypto-idiosyncratic—overlap exists, but the week is not welded to one macro tape.

path.zh: 趋势标签高位震荡：窗口收益为负但幅度有限，更像高位区间内的来回摩擦，而非趋势加速下跌。基准自 10-25 收盘起算，全周未走出干净的单边破位叙事。
path.en: Trend tag is high-level chop: negative window return but limited in size—more range friction at elevation than an accelerating downtrend. From the 10-25 baseline close, the week never wrote a clean one-way break narrative.

leverage.zh:
标签：杠杆中性。
① 拥挤线（OI + 资金费率年化）：周初约 +1.92%/yr → 期末约 +10.95%/yr，租金全周抬升；OI 周变约 +1.68%（93677 → 95252），库存周内抬升，偏加杠杆堆积。
② 出清线（OI + 清算）：主峰日 10-30（2026-10-30）；峰值约 3.95× 周内中位清算量；价格同日约 -0.8%；当日 OI 约 96314；但 OI 周高在 2026-10-31（约 96937），峰值日并非双高；峰值日 OI 较前一日上升，偏改仓/挤压结构而非单纯慢速拆仓。次日 2026-10-31：OI 约 96937、funding 年化约 +10.95%/yr、价格约 +0.3%。
③ 量旁证（永续成交额=活跃度）：周合计约 753.81 亿美金，环比约 +3.7%，活跃度中性；量侧用于核对热闹程度，不拆多空。
收句：拥挤线与出清线并读 → 峰值日并非 OI 周高（无「清算∥OI 双高」）、量旁证偏淡，共同支撑「杠杆中性」；禁止把清算/OI/funding 写成涨跌原因。
leverage.en:
Label: leverage_neutral.
① Crowding (OI + funding ann.): ~+1.92%/yr → ~+10.95%/yr — rent rose over the week; OI week change ~+1.68% (93677 → 95252), inventory up on the week — lean leverage build.
② Flush (OI + liquidations): peak day 2026-10-30; peak ~3.95× median liq qty; price that day ~-0.8%; OI that day ~96314; OI week-high was 2026-10-31 (~96937), not a dual-high peak day; OI up vs prior day — reposition/squeeze structure more than slow unwind. Next day 2026-10-31: OI ~96937; funding ~+10.95%/yr; price ~+0.3%.
③ Volume side (perp turnover = activity): week sum ~75.38B, WoW ~+3.7%, activity normal; activity only, not long/short.
Close: crowding + flush lines → peak day ≠ OI week-high (no liq∥OI dual-high); volume side quieter — supports “leverage_neutral”; do not write liq/OI/funding as the cause of price.

etf.zh: 美现货 BTC ETF 合计净申赎 -2.02 亿美金，通道标签中性/拉锯：4 个净流入日、1 个净流出日，单日最深流出约 -6.43 亿（10-30），最大单日流入约 +1.76 亿（10-27）。ETH 现货 ETF 同期合计约 -4.31 亿、五日皆净流出。Binance 等口径现货成交额周合计约 81.42 亿美金、环比 +6.4%，与 ETF 净流并陈——总量反映热闹程度，不把净流与涨跌焊成因果。
etf.en: US spot BTC ETF aggregate net -202.40M, channel neutral/tug-of-war: 4 inflow days vs 1 outflow day, deepest day ~-643.2M (10-30), largest inflow day ~+176M (10-27). ETH spot ETF ~-431.40M with outflow on all five days. Spot exchange turnover ~8.14B (+6.4% WoW) is shown alongside ETF nets—activity level only; nets are not cast as the cause of the week’s price path.

spot_volume.zh: Binance 现货成交额（turnover 美金，程序周合计）：本周 81.42 亿美金，相对上完整周 +6.4%（活跃度「中性」；上周约 76.53 亿美金）。峰值日 2026-10-29（19.06 亿美金）。这是交易所现货「换手热闹程度」，与 ETF 净申赎同属现货世界、只并陈；对照永续周成交额 753.81 亿美金——两者量级不同，**禁止相加**，也**不能**拆多空。
spot_volume.en: Binance spot turnover (USD, program week sum): this week 8.14B, vs prior full week +6.4% (activity “normal”; prior ~7.65B). Peak day 2026-10-29 (1.91B). Spot tape busyness beside ETF net flow — same spot world, no sum with perp (75.38B); not a long/short split.

vol_teach.zh: 高 RV 说明过去一周路径已经够「吵」；IV 仍高于 RV，意味着权利金相对刚走过的波动仍不便宜，空头波动或长 gamma 的性价比叙事与上周不同，需用点差而不是绝对 IV 单独说话。
vol_teach.en: High RV means the path was already noisy; IV still above RV keeps premium relatively expensive versus what just printed—so any short-vol or long-gamma framing should speak in spread terms, not IV level alone.

vol_week.zh: BTC 实现波动年化约 34.7%，落在「高实现波动」；期末 Deribit IV 约 40.3%，IV−RV 点差约 +5.5 个百分点，期权相对 RV 偏贵。
vol_week.en: BTC realized vol ~34.7% ann. tags high RV; end Deribit IV ~40.3%, IV−RV spread ~+5.5 pts, options rich versus realized.

vol_combo.zh: 价格小幅收负 + 高 RV + IV 溢价同时出现：更像震荡市里的波动定价偏贵，而不是趋势市里的波动崩塌或波动饥渴。
vol_combo.en: Mildly negative price, high RV, and IV premium together read as rich vol pricing inside chop—not a trend-market vol crush or vol drought.

vol_price_iv.zh: BTC 与 ETH（ETH RV ~37.4%，IV ~54.4%）均呈现实现波动不低、IV 更高的结构；价格端同步小回撤，波动端并未因跌幅有限而迅速收敛。
vol_price_iv.en: Both BTC and ETH (ETH RV ~37.4%, IV ~54.4%) show non-low realized with higher IV; prices eased together while vol did not snap shut just because the drawdown stayed moderate.

vol_vix.zh: VIX 窗口约 -0.15%，几乎走平，与加密侧高 RV、IV 偏贵形成温差：传统恐慌指标平静，加密期权/实现波动仍偏热。
vol_vix.en: VIX ~-0.15% on the bracket, nearly flat—temperature gap versus crypto’s high RV and rich IV: TradFi fear gauge calm while crypto vol stayed warmer.

what.zh: 美股隐含波动指数 VIX

vs_crypto.zh: VIX 中低位小动通常解释不了币的大涨跌；与上一节加密 IV 只做角色对照。
vs_crypto.en: Small VIX moves rarely explain big crypto moves; role-parallel to crypto IV only.

vs_crypto.zh: 美元走强时对风险资产偏逆风。
vs_crypto.en: Stronger USD is often a headwind for risk assets.

vs_crypto.zh: 利率与币涨跌若相反，则不是单纯降息交易。
vs_crypto.en: If yields move opposite crypto, this is not a pure cut-trade story.

vs_crypto.zh: 与 BTC 同向可兼容，但是不同资产逻辑。
vs_crypto.en: Same direction as BTC is compatible; drivers still differ.

tradfi_summary.zh: 美股括号内 ES 小负、NQ 明显弱于 ES，黄金同步回撤，美元微升、十年期收益率下行。加密与部分风险资产同向但标签仍为偏独立，避免把本周写成单一「Risk-off 复制」。
tradfi_summary.en: Inside the US Fri–Fri bracket ES mildly down, NQ softer than ES, gold also lower, DXY slightly higher, 10Y yield down. Crypto moved with some risk assets yet stays tagged idiosyncratic—do not collapse the week into a single risk-off copy.

three_conclusions.zh: 高位震荡中的小幅收负，并未改写成趋势崩溃；波动已经偏高，期权相对 RV 仍贵。
three_conclusions.en: Mild loss inside high chop did not rewrite into trend collapse; vol already elevated and options still rich to RV.

three_conclusions.zh: 杠杆中性：funding 温和为正、OI 小增，10-30 清算峰是脉冲出清，不是持续双高拥挤。
three_conclusions.en: Leverage neutral: mild positive funding, slight OI rise, 10-30 liq peak as pulse clearance—not sustained dual-high crowding.

three_conclusions.zh: BTC ETF 周净 -2.02 亿落在中性/拉锯（深流出日与多流入日并存），现货成交额约 81.42 亿美金略增，与杠杆量能并陈、不焊因果。
three_conclusions.en: BTC ETF week net -202.40M sits in neutral/tug-of-war (deep outflow day beside multiple inflow days); spot turnover ~8.14B slightly higher—juxtaposed with leverage activity, not causal glue.

text.zh: 下一周 BTC 现货 ETF 日度净流是否仍以单日大流出后快速拉回为主，通道能否维持中性而非滑向强流出。
text.en: Whether next week’s BTC spot ETF daily nets still feature quick rebounds after any large outflow day, keeping the channel neutral rather than sliding to strong outflow.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周已从净流入周翻成 -2.02 亿的中性/拉锯，且 10-30 单日极深，是最直接的下期核对哨。

text.zh: IV−RV 溢价（目前约 +5.5pt）在高实现波动延续时是否收窄，或 IV 仍系统性偏贵。
text.en: Whether the IV−RV premium (~+5.5 pt now) narrows if high realized vol persists, or IV stays systematically rich.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周核心矛盾之一是「已经够吵但权利金仍贵」，值得用同一口径点差复核。

text.zh: funding 年化与 OI 变动是否继续停留在温和区间，清算是否再现「单日峰而后回落」而非抬升成双高。
text.en: Whether funding ann. and OI change stay in the mild zone, and liquidations remain single-day peaks that fade rather than rising into dual-high crowding.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 杠杆标签中性依赖 funding/OI/清算结构；若三者同步转热，叙事会从中性切换。

matched.zh: 高位震荡 + 窗口小幅收负 + 杠杆中性，路径更像区间摩擦而非趋势延伸，故与 mean_reversion 类「回归/区间」逻辑同向匹配；这是结构标签对齐，不是产品或仓位建议。
matched.en: High chop, mild negative window, and neutral leverage align with mean-reversion / range logic rather than trend extension—label match only, not a product or position call.

mismatched.zh: 趋势跟随在「高位震荡、收益有限、未出现干净突破或加速」的一周里缺乏顺风；标签将 trend_following 列为错配，强调的是环境不合而非策略永废。
mismatched.en: Trend-following lacked tailwind in a high-chop week with limited return and no clean break or acceleration; mismatch flags environment fit, not permanent strategy failure.

disclaimer.zh: 策略环境 = 条件匹配度，不是投资建议；不推荐具体产品，不给出仓位。
disclaimer.en: Strategy backdrop = condition fit, not investment advice; no products, no position sizes.

why.zh: 趋势标签为「高位震荡」，缺少清晰单边趋势条件。
why.en: Trend label “chop_high” lacks a clear one-way trend condition.

note.zh: 旁注：实现波动高或清算偏尖——即便趋势环境在，路径也可能很颠/拥挤。
note.en: Note: high realized vol or liquidation spike — trend backdrop can still be a rough path.

why.zh: 趋势偏震荡/磨盘（高位震荡），更接近区间来回而非单边趋势条件。 但高波宽幅震荡时，回归类也会很颠。
why.en: Trend reads choppy/grind (chop_high); closer to range-bound than one-way trend. Wide high-vol chop is still rough for reversion-style paths.

name.zh: 波动收割/卖保费类环境

why.zh: IV 虽相对偏贵，但实现波动已高——收保费叙事与路径冲击叙事打架，保持中性。
why.en: IV is rich vs RV but realized vol is already high — premium vs path-shock narratives conflict; neutral.

note.zh: 仅描述期权保险费相对实现波动的环境，不是买卖期权或任何产品的建议。
note.en: Describes insurance-vs-realized backdrop only — not advice to trade options or any product.
